notes: New: smart placement. A portal remembers its screen by the monitor itself (its name, native size and serial), so a different cable or port is still the same screen. If that screen is missing, the portal goes to its fallback screen, else…

New: each screen remembers the portal's size and spot there. On a screen it has not been on, the portal keeps its size or is shrunk to fit; it never hangs off the edge. A resize made while away from home belongs to that screen, so home…
Change: the editor's size choices only offer sizes that fit the screen the portal is on, and a custom size cannot exceed it.
Proof: the placement rig gains the missing-screen steps (home gone, fallback gone, away resize, home back, away again) for machines with two or more screens; its test windows are invisible.
